text: Ranked Battles let you compete with Pokémon\nTrainers all over the world.

It’s nerve-racking to battle against Trainers all
over the world.\c
That’s why you should learn every possible way
to battle at the Battle Tower.

Leon...he transformed Rose Tower into the
Battle Tower when he became its owner.\c
He’s no longer the Champion, but he really
wants to make everyone strong!
I admire him!
I’ll keep battling and steadily raise my rank!
